item.text: I’ll inspect Embry’s reference image first, then generate through the built-in `image_gen` tool with that file as the identity reference. After that I’ll place the PNG at the exact requested path and write the receipt from the actual image bytes.

The reference is readable: brown hair tied back, navy top, warm light-tan complexion, rounded jaw, strong brow, expressive brown eyes. I’m generating one 16:9 frame now, keeping Embry large and face-forward enough for identity matching.

Generation finished and the default image file exists under `~/.codex/generated_images`. I’m copying it into the requested cycle frame path, then I’ll compute dimensions and hash from that exact PNG before writing the receipt.

src='/home/graham/.codex/generated_images/019f8b8c-bfba-7dc1-95ed-25304df62064/call_2M6F4g5sMqpKt56JFk0UzB8S.png'
out='/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills-main/skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v3/cycles/cycle_20260722T203423Z/frames/sb_002.attempt_01.png'
receipt='/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills-main/skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v3/cycles/cycle_20260722T203423Z/frames/sb_002.attempt_01_scillm_image_generation_receipt.json'
mkdir -p \""'$(dirname "$out")"
cp "$src" "$out"
read -r width height < <(identify -format '"'%w %h' \""'$out")
sha=$(sha256sum "$out" | awk '"'{print "'$1}'"')
jq -n --arg path \""'$out" --arg sha256 "$sha" --argjson width "$width" --argjson height "$height" '"'{ok:true,auth:\"codex_oauth_image_gen\",path:"'$path,width:$width,height:$height,sha256:$sha256}'"' > \""'$receipt"
test -f "$out"
test -f "$receipt"
ls -l "$out" "$receipt"
printf '"'width=%s height=%s sha256=%s\\n' \""'$width" "$height" "$sha"'

item.text: The PNG did copy to the exact requested frame path. The receipt step tripped on shell parsing of the dimensions, so I’m regenerating only the receipt from the copied PNG bytes and then checking both files.

item.command:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "set -euo pipefail
out='/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills-main/skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v3/cycles/cycle_20260722T203423Z/frames/sb_002.attempt_01.png'
receipt='/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills-main/skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v3/cycles/cycle_20260722T203423Z/frames/sb_002.attempt_01_scillm_image_generation_receipt.json'
dims="'$(identify -format '"'%w %h' \""'$out")
width=${dims%% *}
height=${dims##* }
sha=$(sha256sum "$out" | awk '"'{print "'$1}'"')
jq -n --arg path \""'$out" --arg sha256 "$sha" --argjson width "$width" --argjson height "$height" '"'{ok:true,auth:\"codex_oauth_image_gen\",path:"'$path,width:$width,height:$height,sha256:$sha256}'"' > \""'$receipt"
test -s "$out"
test -s "$receipt"
jq -e '"'.ok == true and .auth == \"codex_oauth_image_gen\" and .path == \"'/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills-main/skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v3/cycles/cycle_20260722T203423Z/frames/sb_002.attempt_01.png'\" and .width == 1536 and .height == 864 and (.sha256|length) == 64' \""'$receipt" >/dev/null
ls -l "$out" "$receipt"
printf '"'width=%s height=%s sha256=%s\\n' \""'$width" "$height" "$sha"'
